controles.affirmation: En decembre 2024, le ministere americain de la Justice est intervenu dans une procedure denonciatrice visant la delivrance d'opioides dans les pharmacies CVS, au titre du Controlled Substances Act et du False Claims Act
controles.verbatim_source: In December 2024, the DOJ intervened in a previously sealed qui tam action and filed an amended complaint in the U.S. District Court for the District of Rhode Island, alleging, among other claims, violations of the federal Controlled Substances Act and the federal False Claims Act based on the filling of opioid and other controlled substance prescriptions at CVS Pharmacy locations nationwide. (10-Q 2026-08-05, Note 8)

controles.affirmation: Provision opioides d'environ 3,4 Mds $ au 30 juin 2026 et incapacite d'estimer la fourchette de perte finale
controles.verbatim_source: As of June 30, 2026, the Company's remaining accrual related to these opioid litigation matters was approximately $3.4 billion ... the Company is not able to reasonably estimate the range of ultimate possible loss for all opioid-related litigation matters at this time (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Deux actions collectives d'actionnaires consolidees a New York sur des omissions relatives a la rentabilite du segment assurance
controles.verbatim_source: Beginning in July 2024, two purported class action complaints ... premised on allegations that the defendants made certain omissions and misrepresentations relating to the profitability of the Health Care Benefits segment. Two purported class actions were filed and have been consolidated in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York. (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Action de mars 2026 accusant Caremark d'avoir retenu des paiements de laboratoires dus a ses clients, sur le fondement de la loi RICO
controles.verbatim_source: Roofers Union Welfare Trust Fund v. CaremarkPCS Health, LLC ... In March 2026, a putative class of Caremark clients filed a new complaint alleging that Caremark breached the parties' contracts, unjustly enriched itself and violated the federal Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations (RICO) Act when it failed to pass through to clients certain payments received by Zinc Health Services, LLC from manufacturers. (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Moody's note la dette long terme Baa3, Fitch maintient une perspective negative, papier commercial note P-3 chez Moody's, S&P a releve sa perspective en mai 2026
controles.verbatim_source: As of June 30, 2026, the Company's long-term debt was rated BBB by Fitch, Baa3 by Moody's and BBB by Standard & Poor's, and its commercial paper program was rated F2 by Fitch, P-3 by Moody's and A-2 by S&P. The outlook on the Company's long-term debt is Negative by Fitch and Stable by Moody's. In May 2026, S&P changed its outlook ... from Negative to Stable. (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: 20 % du chiffre d'affaires consolide vient du gouvernement federal en 2025, 2024 et 2023, dont 79 % (74 %, 73 %) via les contrats CMS
controles.verbatim_source: Health Care Benefits segment revenues from the federal government accounted for approximately 20% of the Company's consolidated total revenues in 2025, 2024 and 2023. Contracts with CMS ... accounted for approximately 79%, 74% and 73%, respectively (10-K FY2025)

controles.affirmation: CMS a arrete pour 2027 une hausse moyenne de revenu de 2,48 % pour l'industrie Medicare Advantage, hors scores de risque
controles.verbatim_source: On April 6, 2026, CMS issued its final notice detailing final 2027 Medicare Advantage payment rates. Final 2027 Medicare Advantage rates resulted in an expected average increase in revenue for the Medicare Advantage industry of 2.48%, excluding the CMS estimate of Medicare Advantage risk score trend. (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: CVS indique elle-meme que l'utilisation des soins devrait rester a des niveaux eleves en 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Utilization persisted at elevated levels in the second quarter of 2026. Although the level of utilization is difficult to accurately predict, utilization beyond current elevated levels may pressure the Company's Health Care Benefits segment and its health care delivery assets in its Health Services segment in 2026. (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: La societe constate un fait passe et dit explicitement que le niveau d'utilisation est difficile a predire ; elle ne pronostique pas un maintien. Reformuler : 'CVS constate que l'utilisation des soins est restee a des niveaux eleves au 2e trimestre 2026 et indique qu'une utilisation superieure a ces niveaux pourrait peser sur le segment assurance en 2026.'

controles.affirmation: Plus de 81 % des adherents Medicare Advantage en plan note au moins 4,0 etoiles pour 2026 contre 88 % l'annee precedente ; plus de 63 % en plan 4,5 etoiles ; CMS durcit son bareme
controles.verbatim_source: Based on the Company's membership as of December 2025, more than 81% of the Company's Medicare Advantage members were in plans with 2026 star ratings of at least 4.0 stars, compared to 88% ... with 2025 star ratings of at least 4.0 stars ; more than 63% ... are in a 4.5-star plan for 2026 ; CMS continues to revise its star ratings system to make it harder to achieve 4 or more stars. (10-K FY2025)

controles.affirmation: Ecart d'acquisition 85 478 M$, incorporels 24 644 M$, capitaux propres 79 702 M$, actif total 253 768 M$ ; capitaux propres tangibles -30,4 Mds $ ; goodwill = 33,7 % de l'actif
controles.verbatim_source: Goodwill 85,478 ; Intangible assets, net 24,644 ; Total CVS Health shareholders' equity 79,702 ; Total assets $253,768 (10-Q T2 2026). Calculs verifies : 79 702 - 85 478 - 24 644 = -30 420 ; 85 478 / 253 768 = 33,7 %

controles.affirmation: Depreciation de 5,7 Mds $ sur Health Care Delivery au T3 2025, solde de goodwill restant ~4,2 Mds $, valeur comptable redevenue egale a la juste valeur sans marge de securite
controles.verbatim_source: resulting in a $5.7 billion goodwill impairment charge, which was recorded during the third quarter of 2025 ... As of December 31, 2025, the remaining goodwill balance in the Health Care Delivery reporting unit was approximately $4.2 billion ... possible in the near term that the goodwill of the Health Care Delivery reporting unit could be deemed to be impaired again by a material amount (10-K FY2025)

controles.affirmation: Dette 61 410 M$ (59 452 + 1 958), tresorerie 11 329 M$, interets payes 1 551 M$ sur six mois, remboursements 3 287 M$ contre 762 M$
controles.verbatim_source: Long-term debt 59,452 ; Current portion of long-term debt 1,958 ; Cash and cash equivalents $11,329 ; Interest paid (1,551) ; Repayments of long-term debt (3,287) | (762) (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Resultat operationnel ajuste S1 : 10 307 M$ contre 8 387 M$, dont HCB +2 166 M$, Health Services +44 M$ (+1,4 %), PCW +21 M$ (+0,8 %), Corporate -311 M$
Health Services : 100 032 M$ de CA au S1 2026 (+11,3 %), marge ajustee de 3,5 % a 3,2 % ; 473,0 millions d'ordonnances traitees au T2 (+0,9 %)

Le PBM partage une part croissante des rabais avec ses clients et offre des garanties de prix minimum qui ne peuvent pas toujours etre tenues ; la societe s'attend a ce que ces tendances se poursuivent
controles.verbatim_source: The Company continues to share with clients a larger portion of rebates, fees and/or discounts received from pharmaceutical manufacturers, and typically offers clients minimum pricing guarantees that cannot always be achieved ... The Company expects these trends to continue. (10-K FY2025, Trends and Uncertainties)

controles.affirmation: Benefice net 1 768 M$ en 2025 contre 4 614 M$ en 2024 et 8 344 M$ en 2023 : recul de 61,7 % en 2025 puis de 44,7 % sur deux ans
controles.verbatim_source: Net income attributable to CVS Health $1,768 | $4,614 | $8,344 | $(2,846) (61.7)% | $(3,730) (44.7)% (10-K FY2025). Dans le tableau de la societe, -61,7 % est la variation 2025/2024 et -44,7 % est la variation 2024/2023, pas une variation sur deux ans.
controles.correction_proposee: Le recul sur deux ans est de -78,8 % (8 344 -> 1 768), pas -44,7 %. Reformuler : 'recul de 61,7 % en 2025, apres un recul de 44,7 % en 2024, soit -78,8 % sur deux ans.'

controles.affirmation: 3 397 M$ de dividendes verses en 2025 (contre 3 373 en 2024 et 3 132 en 2023) pour 1 768 M$ de benefice net, soit 192 % ; 1 725 M$ de dividendes pour 10 594 M$ de flux d'exploitation au S1 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Dividends paid (3,397) | (3,373) | (3,132) (10-K FY2025) ; Dividends paid (1,725) ; Net cash provided by operating activities 10,594 (10-Q T2 2026). 3 397/1 768 = 192 %
